title: set_identity
description: Gives the agent a different device ID while the first message is processed, on connections that did NOT authenticate with the device secret: a new ID when the hardware does not match the claimed device (copied installation), or an existing device's ID when its hardware is recognised (reinstalled PC). Sent before `set_secret` and `server_info`; the rest of the connection already uses the new ID. The agent stores it and uses it in the URL of the next connection.

new_hw_id.description: The device ID to use from now on.
